current_scoring_authority: Only scoring_rules.json awards points. Supporting items and historical records carry no numerical or independent points gates.

items.statement: Ph-mP electronic-state structure and spatial excitation character
items.expected: Determine the low-energy electronic-state structure and spatial excitation character of complete neutral Ph-mP at its isolated-molecule S0 reference geometry. Report the actual vertical S1/T1 energies, S1 oscillator strength and the energy of T_edge, defined as the highest triplet below S1 excluding T1, establishing the boundary from neighboring response states. Use normalized, fragment-defined response/NTO/density evidence to explain what moves between regions and what stays local in S1 and T_edge. The reference has mixed local/interfragment S1 with substantial charge transfer and a mixed T_edge; its boundary label T4 is not a required root identity. These spectroscopic values support the physical-state interpretation and have no separate matching gates. Judge the resulting electronic picture, not an exact matrix of energies, strengths or CT percentages. Real root crossings, mixed states or absence of T_edge can pass when the actual energy ordering and physical response explain that outcome; do not select a different state just because its energy is closer to a source number. This item establishes state properties and does not require endorsing a relaxation route, calculating SOC or claiming kinetic dominance.

Determine which molecular electronic relaxation candidate is supported for Ph-mP using its actual S1/T1/T_edge energy relationships, physical state character and evidence appropriate to the particular proposed route. The reference uses the upper triplet's proximity to S1 compared with the larger S1-T1 gap, together with spatial character, to motivate a high-triplet reverse-ISC candidate. A physically supported alternative route or rejection of this candidate is acceptable; identify any different route state separately from the spectroscopic T_edge. Neither root labels, a small gap alone, state mixing nor a restatement of individual state properties establishes the route inference. No exact energy or CT-percentage gate applies. Bound the conclusion to electronic feasibility; measured RISC rates, kinetic dominance and device efficiencies are not established by these data. Assess this molecule independently of the other emitters.

items.statement: Cross-molecule effect of extending the aromatic substituent
items.expected: Explain from the four-molecule spatial-excitation comparison why increasing aromatic extent does not give a simple monotonic charge-transfer trend. Relate the different hole/electron distribution to the substituent/core structures, with An-S1 local character contrasted against the other S1 mixtures as evidence. This is the relational substituent effect; merely repeating individual state labels or the four pathway conclusions is insufficient. Do not impose unverified fine Ph/Py CT ordering or exact source percentages.
